name: simar-ui
description: A dependency-free, accessible UI library built on native HTML: forms, navigation, data display, feedback and layout, themed with CSS custom properties and configured with HTML attributes.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:docs
scripts.build:css: sass --no-source-map --style=expanded scss/simar-ui.scss dist/simar-ui.css && sass --no-source-map --style=compressed scss/simar-ui.scss dist/simar-ui.min.css
scripts.build:js: esbuild src/simar-ui.js --bundle --loader:.svg=text --format=iife --outfile=dist/simar-ui.js && esbuild src/simar-ui.js --bundle --loader:.svg=text --format=iife --minify --outfile=dist/simar-ui.min.js && esbuild src/charts.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/simar-ui-charts.js && esbuild src/charts.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --outfile=dist/simar-ui-charts.min.js && esbuild src/maps.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/simar-ui-maps.js && esbuild src/maps.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --outfile=dist/simar-ui-maps.min.js && cp src/icons.svg dist/simar-ui-icons.svg
scripts.test:a11y: node tests/a11y.mjs && node tests/wcag22.mjs && node tests/pwa.mjs && node tests/flows.mjs && THEME=light node tests/keyboard.mjs && THEME=dark node tests/keyboard.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:a11y
